summary: An iterator is already available. It can only report whether another element remains, and it can only yield the next element. Wrap it so a caller can inspect the upcoming element without consuming that element. Repeated inspections, before a real yield, must show the same element. A real yield still calls the original step that produces the next element. Write this wrapper that can inspect the upcoming element.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
